artworks.title: Vesper Bells
artworks.medium: photogravure on chine collé mounted on cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman seated, visible from the waist up. She is positioned slightly in profile with her head bowed and hands clasped, resting against her chin. She has a gentle expression with closed eyes. She has smooth hair combed back and wears a shawl over a long-sleeved garment. A skein of yarn and a knitting project are visible beside her on the bench. In the background, there is a wall with a shadow of a cross cast upon it and a small potted plant on a ledge to the right.

artworks.title: A Sketch
artworks.medium: photogravure mounted on light gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man wearing a head covering, a long robe with an intricate pattern, and holding the edges of the robe with both hands. He has facial hair and medium-length hair. The background is blurred.

artworks.title: Ebony and Ivory
artworks.medium: photogravure mounted on gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a seated person holding a small sculpture. The individual is seen in profile, facing leftward, with their full back profile visible. The person has short hair and is nude. The focus is on the sculpture being held, a figurine in a standing position. The background is dark with no specific details.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.medium: photogravure in sepia mounted on light blue wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the head and part of the shoulders of a child facing slightly to the left. The child's facial features are soft and delicate, with a rounded face and wide eyes looking calmly ahead. The child's hair is cut in a simple, straight style with bangs across the forehead. They are wearing dark clothing. The background is dark and unfocused, drawing attention to the child's face. There are no visible objects or jewelry in the frame.

artworks.title: Wet Night, Columbus Circle, New York
artworks.medium: photogravure on chine collé mounted on cream wove paper

artworks.title: Niagara Falls
artworks.medium: photogravure in sepia on chine collé mounted on cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall cascading over a cliff. The viewpoint is slightly below the waterfall, highlighting its height. The horizon is not visible, focusing on the waterfall. A rocky cliff is on the right, guiding the eye upwards. Mist from the water drifts to the left, blending with the cloudy sky. The color scheme is sepia, giving the scene an old-fashioned feel. Textures of rocks and smooth water create contrast.

artworks.title: Beatrice
artworks.medium: photogravure in sepia on chine collé mounted on cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sepia-toned portrait of a woman, capturing her head and upper torso. She is slightly angled to the side, looking towards the camera with a serene expression. Her hair is styled upwards, and she is wearing a gown with a low neckline that covers her shoulders. There are no visible accessories or objects in the image. The background is plain and sepia-toned, adding to the vintage aesthetic.

artworks.title: La Cigale
artworks.medium: photogravure in blue mounted on light gray wove paper
artworks.description: This photograph shows a woman from the waist up, seated or reclining, her body facing us. Her head is slightly tilted to the left, and she looks upward. The woman has pale skin, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, and a thin mouth set in a neutral expression. Her hair appears to be styled into small buns or braids, and it is adorned with a headpiece that features a large crescent moon or half-circle shape with its ends pointing upward. This large shape sits at the center of her forehead and appears to be covered with small gems, with a large gem in the center. Large white flowers are tucked in her hair around her ears. Her attire consists of an off-the-shoulder dress with puffed sleeves and a gathered bodice. Her arms are stretched out to either side, as if they rest on the arms of a chair or couch. The background features a pattern of peacock feathers, and there is a large round shape behind the woman's head, almost like a halo. The photograph is entirely tinted in a blue-gray color.

artworks.title: Odalesque
artworks.medium: photogravure in red mounted on green wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a young child standing and moving through a grassy area. The child has curly, light-colored hair and is smiling. They are not wearing any clothes and are holding a stick-like object in their hands. The background includes dense, blurred vegetation and foliage, indicating a natural setting with trees and plants under soft lighting that gives a sepia tone to the photograph.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.medium: photogravure overmatted and mounted on gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing among flowering trees. She is posed standing with her body slightly facing the left side of the frame and her head turned towards the camera, gently grasping a flowering branch with both hands. She has a serene expression, her hair styled up, and she is wearing a long, light-colored dress with long sleeves that appears to have a delicate pattern on it. The background consists of additional flowering trees and the ground beneath her seems to be grassy or covered with natural foliage. The image is bordered by a large, dark matte.

artworks.title: Lady of Charlotte
artworks.medium: photogravure mounted on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white photograph of a person's head and shoulders in profile. The person has defined facial features, a straight nose, and closed lips. The hair is medium length and framing the face. The individual is wearing a garment with a textured collar around the neck. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is dark, contrasting with the illuminated profile. The photograph is mounted on light brown paper with a signature in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: The Dance
artworks.medium: photogravure in sepia on chine collé mounted on white paper and on dark gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows five children in a room. Three girls in dresses stand in the center holding hands, forming an arch. One child sits on the floor holding a doll, and another child stands near a piano or desk. The children have neatly styled hair and the room is well-furnished with a clock, framed portraits on the walls, and polished flooring.

artworks.title: The Ranchman
artworks.medium: photogravure mounted on gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an elderly man in profile, with distinctive facial features. He has short light-colored hair and a long beard. He wears a wide-brimmed hat and dark clothing. The background is dark, and the photo is framed in matte gray with a note in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Shylock--A Sketch
artworks.medium: photogravure in sepia printed on thick beige paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a three-quarter length portrait, facing slightly to the right with the left arm extended outward and the right hand resting on their chest. The person's facial features include a prominent nose and deep-set eyes, framed by long, wavy hair that appears slightly disheveled. The person wears a dark coat with a wide collar over a light shirt that has a cravat tied at the neck, and a sash tied around the waist. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or held objects. The background is a plain, dark backdrop, and the entire image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Coquette
artworks.medium: photogravure in blue on chine collé mounted on white paper and on gray paper
artworks.description: The photograph depicts a person from the waist up, sitting with their head tilted to one side and chin resting on their hand. They have wavy light-colored hair, a wide-brimmed dark hat, and fine facial features. The person wears a dark flowing shawl over a light-colored dress. In the background is an indistinct, softly blurred backdrop. The image is presented on a textured gray mat with the photographer's signature on the border.

artworks.title: A Study Head
artworks.medium: photogravure mounted on light gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of a woman, featuring her head and shoulders in a slight three-quarter profile. Her facial features are soft and delicate, with a serene expression. She wears a light-colored bonnet or hat that frames her face, and a light-colored garment. The background is indistinct, and the photograph is bordered by a gray matte.

artworks.title: A Study
artworks.medium: photogravure in red on chine collé mounted on white paper and on gray wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (diameter): 11.3 x 11.3 cm (4 7/16 x 4 7/16 in.)
sheet: 13.6 x 12.7 cm (5 3/8 x 5 in.)
mount: 28.5 x 19.5 cm (11 1/4 x 7 11/16 in.)
mount: 38.1 x 28 cm (15 x 11 in.)
artworks.description: The image portrays the upper portion of a woman's body in profile. She faces to the right, displaying her shoulders, neck, and head. Her hair is styled in an updo secured with a ribbon or band. The woman has a gentle expression, with prominent features like her nose and lips. She is not wearing any clothing, bringing focus to her neck, shoulders, and hair. The background is neutral, and the composition is enclosed within a circular frame. The portrait is mounted on a matte board with a signature in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: A Field Mouse, from Below
artworks.medium: watercolor with graphite and black pen and ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rodent with a plump body, small limbs, and a long tail. The fur is a combination of brown and grey tones. The front teeth are prominently displayed. There is a separate sketch of the rodent's head on the right side. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Three Bacchic Children
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two putti with a barrel in a natural landscape. The scene features cherubic figures among trees and foliage, interacting with the barrel. The fine line work shows detailed textures of both the surroundings and the figures. The composition has a classical feel with intricate detailing, hatching, and cross-hatching techniques emphasizing shadows and depth. Handwritten text below the image indicates it might be an artist's sketch or an etching capturing a moment of innocence in a wooded setting.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated reading an open book. He has a large forehead, thinning hair on top, fuller, curly hair on the sides and back, a full beard, and a focused expression. He wears a loose robe and a sword at his side. His hands are engaged with the book, one resting on the page and the other supporting it. The background is a simple design with linear shading, resembling a wall or tapestry in a dimly lit setting. The bottom of the image contains text labeling the subject as "S. PAVLVS."

artworks.title: Pool in a Formal Garden
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil scene with clusters of trees lining the horizon. A sculpted figure sits on a pedestal on the right side, partially hidden by tall grasses. The brushstrokes are fine and intricate, emphasizing the detailing of foliage and water texture. The color palette is warm sepia tones. In the distance, there are faint clouds, a few birds in the sky, and a far tree line for added depth.

artworks.title: Diana Recumbent
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body view of a reclining person with closed eyes. They have short, wavy hair and one arm resting on their forehead while the other lies alongside their body. The person appears to be nude and is lying on a piece of fabric. A sleeping dog is positioned beside them. In the background, detailed illustrations of trees and foliage create a dense natural setting. Smaller figures or animals are seen in the distance among the trees, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: A Rocky Pond
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 10.2 x 15.6 cm (4 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a landscape view with a natural scene depicted in fine etching. The horizon is situated towards the middle of the composition, where the land gently rises, and a subtle outline of distant hills is visible. Large rocks and foliage are depicted close to us, with a lone, barren tree extending upwards on the left side. The etching features intricate and well-defined brushstrokes, including thin lines and cross-hatching to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark tones against a lighter background. In the distance, additional clusters of trees can be seen, rendered with similar linework to convey movement and detail.

artworks.title: A Rocky Pond
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, rocks, and water. The perspective is slightly elevated. Rocks are prominent in the central area, with various shapes and textures. Trees and foliage are depicted with detailed brushstrokes. The color scheme is sepia, creating a warm and vintage atmosphere. The scene includes water reflecting rocks, distant hills, and faint cloud formations.
